description: Control the OpenCode Zen relay: start, stop, check status, or list available models. The relay forwards requests from BSH's OpenCode Zen provider to the free Zen catalog.

action.description: Action to perform on the relay.

port.description: Loopback port for the relay. Defaults to 18765, which is the port the contributed provider points at.

check.description: Fetch the live Zen catalog to prove upstream reachability. Defaults to true.
